messages:
ajay: CI alert — audit-validator started failing on master after the RBAC change. Several golden fixtures in eng-security are mismatching; failures look related to role prefix and KMS path shapes.
security-bot: [ci] 12 tests failed in validators/audit — https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/1002 (flaky=false)
marlo: repro from unit test: 
```
expected actor.role = "service:dedicated-agent"
actual   actor.role = "dedicated-agent"
assertion: mismatch on role prefix
```
lina: that matches the RBAC PR that removed the "service:" prefix to normalize identities. Validator still expects the old canonical form. :thinking:
ajay: also seeing KMS field diffs. Golden fixture has `kmsKeyId: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/foo/cryptoKeys/bar` but runtime events have `kmsKeyId: keyRings/foo/cryptoKeys/bar` after keystore migration.
sam: can we normalize both to compare suffix-only? e.g., assert endsWith(`/cryptoKeys/bar`) and ignore the project/locations prefix in CI. That avoids churn for infra migrations.
marlo: masking/suffix-compare seems safest. But product/legal: do we allow stripping full KMS path in customer-facing audit logs? @lina any constraints?
lina: product is ok with storing a normalized/safe form in our telemetry. For customer-visible audit exports we should keep the full path if the customer has opted-in and we document it. For validators we should canonicalize to a stable compare key.
ajay: proposed fix: 1) add a normalizer layer in audit-validator that canonicalizes actor.role to drop or add the `service:` prefix consistently, and normalizes kmsKeyId to a stable suffix key (e.g., `/cryptoKeys/<name>`). 2) run a one-off update to golden fixtures with `tools/generate_audit_fixtures --normalize` 3) add CI gating to assert fixture metadata indicates if full KMS paths are allowed 4) add a small canary job to prevent regressions.
sam: I sketched a draft PR implementing the normalizer + updated fixtures: https://git.redwood.ai/r/1234 — includes unit tests and a migration helper.
security-bot: SEC-2026 created: "audit-validator: fixture drift after RBAC & keystore migration" (priority=P2).
marlo: quick review: normalizer code looks fine but please add an explicit opt-in flag for allowing full KMS paths in golden fixtures so we don't accidentally commit customer secrets.
ajay: agreed. I'll add `allow_full_kms_paths=false` by default in fixture metadata and require an explicit bolt-on for exports.
ci-bot: rerun triggered by @ajay — build 1003 queued.
lina: also add a test that asserts no golden fixture contains the full customer KMS path unless metadata `allow_full_kms_paths=true`. That will catch future infra migrations.
sam: will add that test and update the PR.
ajay: rollout plan: merge validator canonicalizer behind a FeatureFlag, deploy to staging, run canary dataset, flip flag for the validator pipeline, then update production fixtures. I'll update the incident/runbook note to include steps for reversing the change if we see missing data in customer exports.
marlo: small nit — add a short note in the changelog about this behavior change so on-call and support can explain to customers.
ajay: will add CHANGES.md blurb.
lina: thanks — once PR lands, schedule a short sync with support and product to confirm messaging. :thumbsup:
ajay: thanks all, I'll post follow-up when PR merges and canary is green.
marlo: thanks — ping me if you want me to run the staging canary. :eyes:
